$comment: Recorded C6 hello lines, byte-for-byte as shims write them (src/contracts/shim-protocol.ts). Never edit a valid line: a live shim still sends it. unsupported = well-formed hellos from a newer generation, answered with the unsupported_generation welcome. transitions = the hellos one shim writes, in order, across a pre-initialize reconnect case (shim-protocol.ts ShimState table); the last one resumes exactly when phaseAfter is init-done, and initializeResponses is how many initialize responses reached the client (never more than one). initializedRead = whether the shim had read notifications/initialized when it sent its last hello; that hello resumes with exactly that flag. stateAfter permanent_fallback with errorSent = a case that ends without a hello.

unsupported.name: gen-3 with fields we do not know

transitions.name: drop in init-pending, reconnect within the deadline
transitions.event: reconnect within SHIM_INITIAL_CONNECT_DEADLINE_MS; initialize re-sent with the same id

transitions.name: drop in init-pending, no reconnect within the deadline
transitions.event: pending initialize answered locally once; the next successful connect resumes

transitions.name: FALLBACK entered in idle
transitions.event: initial-connect deadline with no initialize buffered; first successful connect

transitions.name: FALLBACK with a buffered initialize
transitions.event: initial-connect deadline answers the buffered initialize locally; first successful connect

transitions.name: local initialize between hello and welcome
transitions.event: hello(resume:null) sent; the initial-connect deadline answers the buffered initialize locally before the welcome; that attempt is abandoned and a new hello carries the new snapshot

transitions.name: local initialize before the client sent notifications/initialized
transitions.event: the initial-connect deadline answers the buffered initialize locally; the first successful connect happens before the client's notifications/initialized is read, so the resume says initialized:false and the server waits for the notification

transitions.name: resume hello past the size limit
transitions.event: a drop after init-done; the cached initialize would push the resume hello past SHIM_HELLO_MAX_BYTES, so no hello is sent: the next host-bound request gets reinitialize_required once and the shim enters permanent_fallback
